newsitem.title: USA: Hughes unit to share in $1.0 bln contract.
newsitem.headline: Hughes unit to share in $1.0 bln contract.

text.p: Hughes Aircraft Co, a unit of Hughes Electronics Corp, said Thursday it will act as the major subcontractor on a $1.0 billion Raytheon Co contract for upgrading government air traffic systems.

The work covers modernization of the Federal Aviation Administration's terminal automation equipment at up to 371 facilities and could mean "several hundred million dollars over the life of the contract" to Hughes, it said.
Under the contract, called STARS for Standard Terminal Automation Replacement System, Hughes will install its TracView air traffic control products for emergency backup.
